# Reversi

> Free browser Reversi at https://redreamality.com/reversi/ — play the classic 8×8 disc-flipping board game against a computer AI (you play Black) or with a second person on the same screen. No download, no account. Works on phones and desktop.

What the game offers (and does not):
- Modes: you vs the AI, or 2 players taking turns on one device. No online multiplayer.
- One AI strength (Monte Carlo tree search, up to about 8 seconds per move). No difficulty levels.
- Options: show/hide legal-move dots; when a player has no legal move, either they pass (default) or the game ends.
- Games are not saved between visits.
- No comment section, accounts or data collection beyond a local "Like" flag.
- Contact and copyright notices: https://github.com/redreamality/reversi/issues (public)
- Game engine: UCThello by Oliver Merkel, MIT License.

## Pages

- [Play Reversi](https://redreamality.com/reversi/): the game, rules, how to play, tips (corners, edges, X- and C-squares, mobility, fewer discs early) and FAQ
- [How to Play Reversi](https://redreamality.com/reversi/rules.html): the full rules with diagrams; starting position, Black moves first, legal moves, flips in several directions, no chain flips, passing, early endings with empty squares, ties, and a printable one-page summary
- [Reversi Strategy](https://redreamality.com/reversi/strategy.html): how to win at Reversi; corners, X- and C-squares, mobility, edges, frontier discs and quiet moves, endgame parity, a beginner opening and how to approach the AI here, each with a board diagram
- [About](https://redreamality.com/reversi/about.html): about the site and the open-source engine license
- [Contact](https://redreamality.com/reversi/contact.html)
- [Privacy Policy](https://redreamality.com/reversi/privacy.html)
- [Terms of Service](https://redreamality.com/reversi/terms.html)
